Medium only because SKILL.md:20 has `pip install azure-ai-contentunderstanding` (official Azure SDK package). All analysis, create and delete calls are sample code for the user's application against example.com placeholder URLs; no instruction for the agent to read, print, or send real secrets.

Content sent to the service (documents, audio, video) leaves the user's machine when their code runs.
